newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Philippine peso, Slovak crown bonds get ISMA nod.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso, Slovak crown bonds get ISMA nod.

text.p: The International Securities Market Association (ISMA) said on Thursday it had amended its rules and recommendations to include Philippine peso and Slovak crown bonds.

"Philippine peso and Slovak crown bonds possess the basic features of international securities falling under the auspices of ISMA's rules and recommendations, (so we) unanimously concluded the ISMA's rules be amended accordingly," ISMA said at its annal general meeting on Thursday.
Bonds denominated in euros will also be included by ISMA once the European single currency is introduced.
ISMA is the self-regulatory industry body and trade association for the international securities market. It has 820 members in 51 countries.
